sruja.name: Add EventBus Node Kind
sruja.description: Add support for a new node kind 'EventBus' to the Sruja scanner. This should involve updating the NodeKind enum in sruja-scan and ensuring it's handled in the graph representation.

sruja.name: Implement 'Go to Neighbors' LSP Command
sruja.description: Implement a new custom LSP command 'sruja/getNeighbors' in the sruja-lsp crate that uses the graph to return neighbor information for a given file/component.

sruja.name: Implement JSONL Exporter
sruja.description: Add a new export format 'jsonl' to the sruja-export crate. It should emit the graph nodes and edges as line-delimited JSON objects.

express.name: Add Audit Middleware
express.description: Add a middleware that logs all incoming requests to an external 'Auditor' service via HTTP. The middleware should be configurable to exclude sensitive paths.
